about.headline: Software architecture
about.headlineAccent: Every technical decision accounts for maintainability, security, and scalability. Design precedes implementation, automated tests validate changes, and deployments are automated.

performance.title: Web performance & SEO
performance.description: SSR, CDNs and optimized images for fast loads and strong search rankings.

async.title: Queues & background jobs
async.description: BullMQ and Redis queues with retries, backoff and idempotency.

security.title: Secure APIs & authentication
security.description: Token rotation, RBAC, rate limiting and encrypted secrets.

design.title: System design
design.description: Data models, APIs and modules designed to grow without rewrites.

quality.title: Automated testing & CI/CD
quality.description: Tests and pipelines that block the merge when something breaks.

ai.title: AI-assisted development
ai.description: Claude Code and Antigravity integrated into the development workflow, with code review and testing as quality control.

about.techSubtitle: A solid, current command of the development ecosystem means choosing the right tool for each system and using it optimally. Automation and a modern engineering workflow speed up delivery without compromising technical rigor, code quality, or performance.

ecommerce.title: La Casa del Balompié
ecommerce.description: E-commerce store for official and custom soccer jerseys with shipping across Guatemala. Catalog of clubs and national teams in fan and player versions, with size guide, shopping cart, and direct WhatsApp ordering. Client project, in production.

qably.title: Qably Development AI
qably.description: AI-powered QA platform that ingests CI/CD reports, generates test cases from code changes, and links test runs to commits, branches, and pull requests. Flaky test detection, multi-tenant architecture, more than 4,900 automated tests, and BullMQ and Redis queues. Personal project.

envault.title: EnVault Management
envault.description: Automated backup system for PostgreSQL and MySQL that schedules, queues, and sends backups to Cloudflare R2 and restores them with real-time progress tracking. BullMQ and Redis queues, retries with backoff, distributed locks to run across replicas, and SHA-256 verification before restoring. Personal project.

saas.title: Restaurant SaaS
saas.description: Multi-tenant platform for restaurants in Guatemala where each one manages its own landing page with one of two designs, Urban or Elegant, and sells online with a digital menu and direct WhatsApp orders. Dashboard with Kanban-style order management, push notifications, sound alerts, and sales analytics. Personal project.

mps.title: MPS de Guatemala
mps.description: E-commerce store in Guatemala selling computers, networking, accessories, and security equipment, with nationwide shipping. Server-side rendering, role-based admin panel with analytics, stock control that prevents overselling, and real-time order tracking. Client project, delivered and being prepared for launch.

turboauto.title: Turbo Auto
turboauto.description: Website for a car wash and mechanic shop in Quesada, Jutiapa. Presents washing services for cars, motorcycles, and buses, chassis flushing, and mechanical repairs, plus an exclusive weekly deals section. Client project.

contact.title: From design to production
contact.subtitle: Every project, whether personal or built for clients, follows the same cycle. It starts by analyzing the problem and designing an architecture built to grow without rewrites. Development relies on automated validation and deployment workflows that ensure the integrity and security of every product, and the cycle ends with stable software in production.

seo.title: Isaac Sarceño | Software Engineer
seo.description: Software engineer in Guatemala. Design and development of SaaS and e-commerce platforms with React, TypeScript, and Node.js, from architecture to deployment.
